provenance: Flattened Consolidated Statements of Income and Cash Flows transcribed from Alphabet's FY2024 Form 10-K (filed 2025-02-05). FY2024 Revenues 350,018, Income from operations 112,390, and Net cash provided by operating activities 125,299 match assets/filings/PEER_SOURCES.md. Comparative 2022–2023 columns are from the same statement pages and are used only to exercise year binding.
